name: @lanka-playgrounds/solid-spa
description: Atlas in Solid: one project that is both a Vite single-page application and a server renderer, with compiled JSX and the same ViewModels every other host reads.

scripts.//dev: The application, against the API on port 4380. Start the server first.
scripts.//build:app: NOT `build`. `pnpm verify:build` is `pnpm -r run build` and it exists to check what is PUBLISHED.
scripts.//test: TWO runs, because the same components are compiled twice: for the DOM under jsdom, and into a string under node. `vite-plugin-solid` decides that per CONFIG, so one config cannot hold both — `vitest.server.config.ts` says why at length.
